verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents user-controlled retention for AI Object Storage through bucket lifecycle policies (Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload). Users can also manage and delete objects in the Cloud Console, manage bucket policies via Terraform, and delete clusters via the API. This covers object-level retention and deletion, but the privacy side of the story is not documented. missing for 10: a platform-wide data retention policy (how long CoreWeave keeps customer data or logs, including Inference request data), deletion guarantees or secure-erase on account or cluster teardown, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
